reasoning: This question asks whether the daily average temperature at Caen-Carpiquet Airport will be higher on November 2, 2025 than on October 26, 2025. The forecast date is October 16, 2025, so we're predicting 10-17 days into the future. In late October/early November in northern France (Normandy), temperatures typically decline as winter approaches. October 26 is earlier in autumn while November 2 is later. Climatologically, we'd expect cooler temperatures in early November than late October. However, day-to-day weather variability is substantial, and a warm spell could occur on Nov 2 while Oct 26 is cooler. Given the seasonal trend toward cooling and the inherent unpredictability of specific daily temperatures 10+ days out, I estimate the probability that Nov 2 is warmer than Oct 26 at roughly 35-40%, with the base rate favoring Oct 26 being warmer due to the seasonal progression.
